title: Warmly Roasted Canadian Maple Syrup Glazed Pecans Tart
description: A light and show-off Canadian dish featuring icing sugar and deglaze-fond, perfect for special occasions. This macrobiotic-friendly tart is a delightful combination of roasted pecans and maple syrup.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the flour, icing sugar, and salt.
Add the melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and place it in a tart pan.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the maple syrup and chopped pecans.
Pour the maple syrup and pecan mixture into the tart crust.
Bake the tart for 35 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool.
Drizzle the tart with additional maple syrup if desired.
